launcher.release_notes:
cx-labs-launcher: 0.10.4 — auto-sync install credentials into cluster's otel-integration (#151)

Fix a real UX gap that's been in every version since the install-creds
modal existed: changing the Send-Your-Data Key or Team Name in Settings
persisted to state.json and stopped there. The `otel-integration` helm
release baked in the OLD values at install time and kept using them, so
cluster telemetry silently kept flowing to the old team. Toast said
"✓ Install credentials saved" — technically true but misleading.

After saveInstallCreds succeeds:
- If the active target is a launcher-managed kind cluster (its context
  matches kind-cx-labs-kind-*), automatically run apply_cluster_toggles
  with the current toggle state. That's the same code path Cluster
  generators uses — terraform + helm upgrade otel-integration with the
  new CX_DATA_KEY / CX_DOMAIN / CX_TEAM_NAME env vars, ~30s.
- If the active target is an external context (EKS, GKE, someone's real
  cluster), we can't touch their releases from here — toast tells them
  to update the helm chart manually.
- If no target is selected yet (pre-first-install), no-op.

Failure is non-fatal: state.json is already written, and the toast tells
the user to click Apply on Cluster generators to retry. The manual path
remains available for anyone who hits the auto-sync bug.

Scope-limited to Send-Your-Data / Team / Domain (the reported bug).
Personal API Key changes still require redeploying affected scenarios
(the cx-training-coralogix Secret is written only at deploy time); that
warning is already in the UI. Automating THAT is a v0.10.5 candidate.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
